nodes.text: There's an ongoing concern about the spread of HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) in India, with cases reported in Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, and Karnataka. Authorities are taking measures similar to those used during the Covid-19 response to manage potential outbreaks.
